sections.title: Implementation Plan: Sales Item Management System
Summary
sections.raw_content: The goal is to build a dynamic, interactive client-side application for managing items for sale. The system will feature a responsive gallery with real-time search, category/availability filtering, and dynamic sorting. An administrative interface will allow full CRUD operations on the item catalog. The technical approach leverages semantic HTML5, modular CSS (BEM), and modern ES6+ JavaScript, with data persistence handled via `localStorage` to ensure a serverless, portable implementation.

sections.title: Technical Context
sections.raw_content:
**Language/Version**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+)

**Primary Dependencies**: None (Vanilla JS)

**Storage**: `localStorage` (Browser-based persistence)

**Testing**: Manual browser testing across Chrome, Firefox, and Safari; W3C HTML/CSS Validation.

**Target Platform**: Modern Web Browsers (Desktop & Mobile)

**Project Type**: Web Application (Frontend-only)

**Performance Goals**: Instant UI updates for filtering/sorting (<100ms); 60fps animations for modals.

**Constraints**: Offline-capable (via LocalStorage); No external backend dependencies.

**Scale/Scope**: Small-scale catalog (up to 1000 items); Single-page application (SPA) feel.

sections.title: Constitution Check
sections.raw_content:
*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

- [x] **Semantic HTML**: Plan uses HTML5 semantic tags for accessibility and SEO.
- [x] **Modular CSS**: BEM naming and CSS Variables are planned for the styling layer.
- [x] **Modern JS**: ES6+ syntax and modular structure (JS modules) are required.
- [x] **Separation of Concerns**: No inline styles or event handlers; strict file separation.
- [x] **Responsive-First**: Mobile-first approach with Flexbox/Grid is the default.

**Status**: PASSED

structural_gaps.remediation_advice: The plan mentions a data-model.md to be produced in Phase 1, but the current document lacks the actual data schemas for the items.
While this is a frontend-only app, internal module contracts or data flow diagrams between modules are not explicitly defined in this plan.
Security considerations for localStorage data integrity or XSS prevention in the admin CRUD interface are not addressed.
No explicit open questions or uncertainties are documented, though aspects like image upload handling in a serverless context remain unclear.
